description: Which councils HouseFile’s records cover: each council with published schemes, with how many, how many are in force and when they were last verified, and the councils checked and found to run none. Use it to tell the user honestly whether their area is covered, and list_council_schemes for one council’s detail.
name: licensing_coverage

checked_no_scheme_councils.description: Short names of the councils a person checked and found to run no additional or selective scheme. list_council_schemes gives the date

council_count.description: Every council the records cover, with schemes or checked and found to run none

councils.description: Councils with published schemes. Councils checked and found to run none are in checked_no_scheme_councils

name.description: The council’s short name, as on HouseFile’s pages. list_council_schemes takes it as it is

title: Which councils are covered
